ja: 古池や蛙とびこむ水の音
en:
The old pond
a frog leaps in
the sound of water

ja: 閑さや岩にしみ入るせみの聲
en:
Such stillness
the cicadas' voices
seep into stone

ja: 夏草や兵どもが夢の跡
en:
Summer grasses
all that remains
of warriors' dreams

ja: 五月雨を集めて早し最上川
en:
Gathering the summer rains
how swiftly
the Mogami runs

ja: 荒海や佐渡に橫ふ天の川
en:
A rough sea
the Milky Way stretches
across to Sado

ja: 秋深き隣は何をする人ぞ
en:
Autumn deepens
what does my neighbor
do with their days?

ja: 旅に病んで夢は枯野をかけめぐる
en:
Ill on the road
my dreams still wander
across the withered fields

ja: 海暮れて鴨の聲ほのかに白し
en:
Dusk over the sea
the ducks' voices
faintly white

ja: 旅人と我名呼ばれん初時雨
en:
Let them call me Traveler
the first winter shower

ja: 初時雨猿も小簑をほしげなり
en:
The first winter shower
even the monkey seems to want
a little straw cape

ja: 花の雲鐘は上野か淺草か
en:
A cloud of blossoms
is that bell from Ueno
or Asakusa?

ja: 此道や行く人なしに秋の暮
en:
This road
with no one on it
an autumn evening

ja: 雲をり〳〵人を休める月見哉
en:
Clouds from time to time
give us a rest
from moon-viewing

ja: 名月や北國日和定めなき
en:
Harvest moon
how changeable the weather
in the northern country

ja: 初雪や水仙の葉のたわむ程
en:
First snow
just enough to bend
the narcissus leaves

ja: 初雪やかけかゝりたる橋のうへ
en:
First snow
on the bridge
still being built

ja: 茶の花に人里ちかき山路哉
en:
Tea blossoms by the mountain path
a village must be near

ja: 梅が香にのつと日の出る山路哉
en:
Through the scent of plum blossoms
the sun suddenly rises
on the mountain path

ja: 霞やら花の雲やら煙やら
en:
Is it haze
a cloud of blossoms
or smoke?

ja: 春なれや名もなき山の朝霞
en:
So it is spring
morning haze
on a nameless mountain

ja: 春の海ひねもすのたりのたりかな
en:
The spring sea
all day long
rolling gently on

ja: 菜の花や月は東に日は西に
en:
Rapeseed blossoms
the moon in the east
the sun in the west

ja: 涼しさや鐘をはなるるかねの音
en:
Such coolness
the sound of the bell
leaves the bell behind

ja: 夏河を越すうれしさよ手に草履
en:
The joy of crossing
a summer river
sandals in my hand

ja: 牡丹散て打かさなりぬ二三片
en:
The peony sheds
two or three petals
one over another

ja: 狐火やいづこ河内の麦畠
en:
Foxfire
somewhere in the wheat fields
of Kawachi

ja: さみだれや大河を前に家二軒
en:
Summer rains
two houses facing
a great river

ja: 去年より又さびしひぞ秋の暮
en:
Lonelier still
than last year
this autumn dusk

ja: あちらむきに鴫も立たり秋の暮
en:
Facing away
a snipe takes flight
at autumn dusk

ja: 弓取に哥とはれけり秋の暮
en:
A warrior asks me
about poetry
autumn dusk

ja: 秋の暮辻の地藏に油さす
en:
Autumn dusk
replenishing the lamp
at the roadside Jizō

ja: 月天心貧しき町を通りけり
en:
The moon straight overhead
I pass through
a poor neighborhood

ja: 山は暮て野は黄昏の薄哉
en:
The mountains darken
in the field, twilight
and silver grass

ja: 鳥羽殿へ五六騎急ぐ野分かな
en:
Five or six riders

in the autumn gale

ja: 狐火や髑髏に雨のたまる夜に
en:
Foxfire
on a night when rain
collects in a skull

ja: 水鳥や舟に菜を洗ふ女有
en:
Waterbirds
a woman in a boat
washing greens

ja: 水鳥や枯木の中に駕二挺
en:
Waterbirds
among the bare trees
two palanquins

ja: 易水にねぶか流るゝ寒かな
en:
A leek drifts down
the Yi River
how cold it is

ja: 斧入れて香におどろくや冬こだち
en:
The axe bites
the scent takes me by surprise
a winter grove

ja: うまさふな雪やふふはりふふはりと
en:
Delicious-looking snow
drifting down
ever so softly

ja: 旅人がかきねにはさむおち穂哉
en:
A traveler tucks
a fallen ear of rice
into the hedge

ja: やれ打な蝿が手をすり足をする
en:
Wait, don't swat it
the fly rubs its hands
rubs its feet

ja: 笠でするさらばさらばやうすがすみ
en:
A wave of the hat

through the thin haze

ja: 評判の八重山ざくらあゝ老ぬ

That famous double mountain cherry

ja: 門の木の阿房烏も初声ぞ
en:
Even the fool crow
in the tree by the gate

ja: 雀の子そこのけ〳〵御馬が通る
en:
Little sparrow

In the shade of the pines

ja: 足枕手まくら鹿のむつまじや
en:
Pillowed on each other's legs

the deer lie together

ja: なくななくなそれ程まめでかへる雁

Don't cry, don't cry

ja: させる夜もなくてふりゆく萩の花

No night in particular
as the bush clover

ja: 坊主憎けりゃ袈裟まで憎い

ja: 子を見ること親に如かず

ja: 精神一到何事か成らざらん

ja: 渇しても盗泉の水を飲まず

ja: 瓜の蔓に茄子はならぬ

ja: 溺れる者は藁をも掴む

hardship makes the man
seeing is believing

third time lucky

ja: 衣食足りて礼節を知る

ja: 風が吹けば桶屋が儲かる
en: any event can bring about an effect in an unexpected way

ja: 口では大坂の城も建つ
en: talk is cheap

ja: 三尺去って師の影を踏まず

ja: 壁に耳あり障子に目あり

easy come, easy go
time waits for no man
deep rivers move in silence; shallow brooks are noisy

one cannot have pleasure without pain

ja: 一年の計は元旦にあり

ja: 本木にまさる末木なし
en: of soup and love, the first is the best

ja: 目は口ほどに物を言う
en: the eyes speak as much as the mouth

ja: 金の切れ目が縁の切れ目
en: relationships formed by wealth will end when the money ends
in traveling, a companion; in life, sympathy

ja: 人の口には戸が立てられない
en: you can't control what people say

en: hardship in youth is worth buying
men should be brave, women should be affable
there's always room for dessert
half a loaf is better than none

ja: 少年老い易く学成り難し
en: youth fades quickly, learning comes slowly

ja: 一寸の光陰軽んずべからず
en: there isn't a moment to be wasted
a poor man has no time for leisure

ja: 天は自ら助くる者を助く
en: heaven helps those who help themselves
the pen is mightier than the sword
a jack of all trades is a master of none
speech is silver, silence is golden
strike while the iron is hot

ja: 働かざる者食うべからず
en: he who does not work shall not eat

ja: 死んで花実が咲くものか
en: once you're dead, that's it
with time we forget those who have died
the blind leading the blind

ja: 己の欲せざる所は人に施す勿れ
en: do not do unto others what you would not have done unto you
love your enemies
love your neighbor

ja: 過ちて改めざるこれを過ちという
en: a man who has committed a mistake and doesn't correct it is committing another mistake

ja: 千金の裘は一狐の腋に非ず
en: to rule a country requires many great men

ja: 宝さかって入る時はさかって出る
en: ill-gotten gains fade as fast as they were obtained

ja: 犬も歩けば棒に当たる
en: bad things happen to those who attempt things
the proof of the pudding is in the eating
a gentle spirit is more important than looks
children are a bond between husband and wife

ja: 月夜の晩ばかりじゃない
en: it won't always be a moonlit night (watch your back)
curiosity killed the cat

ja: 親しき仲にも礼儀あり
en: courtesy matters even between close friends
victory depends on the turn of fortune
followers take after their leaders
a man's word is his bond
if you are prepared you don't have to worry

ja: 情けは人のためならず
en: the good you do for others is good you do yourself

ja: 冬来たりなば春遠からじ
en: when winter comes spring isn't far behind
experience is the best teacher
it's always darkest before the dawn

ja: 日光を見ずして結構と言うなかれ
en: see Nikko and die

ja: 船頭多くして船山に登る
en: too many cooks spoil the broth

ja: 女房と畳は新しい方が良い
en: wives and tatami mats are best when new

ja: 案ずるより産むが易し
en: it is easier to do something than worry about it
the soul of a three-year-old lasts to a hundred

ja: 幽霊の正体見たり枯れ尾花
en: the ghost turned out to be withered pampas grass
smooth words make smooth ways

ja: 過ぎたるは及ばざるがごとし
en: too much is as bad as too little
food over romance
speak of the devil and he shall appear
the best time for doing something is as soon as you've thought of it
great men have great fondness for the sensual pleasures
honesty does not pay

ja: 鬼が出るか蛇が出るか
en: God only knows what may happen
prevention is better than cure

ja: 下手な考え休むに似たり
en: it's hard to tell a poor thinker from a sleeping one
do not chase the one who leaves
turn away no one

ja: 用心するに越したことはない
en: you can never be too careful
see Naples and die

ja: ローマは一日にして成らず
en: Rome was not built in a day

ja: 悪人は畳の上では死ねない
en: a bad person does not deserve to die in his own bed
a law is a law, however undesirable it may be
whatever will be, will be

ja: 衣ばかりで和尚はできぬ
en: the clothes do not make the man

ja: 一寸の虫にも五分の魂
en: tread on a worm and it will turn

ja: 一銭を笑う者は一銭に泣く
en: laugh at a penny and you'll weep for a penny
faith will move mountains

ja: 嘘つきは泥棒の始まり
en: show me a liar, and I will show you a thief
there's no flying from fate

ja: 遠くの親類より近くの他人
en: a stranger nearby is better than a relative far away
poor speakers make long speeches

ja: 可愛さ余って憎さ百倍
en: the greatest hate proceeds from the greatest love

ja: 火のないところに煙は立たない
en: there's no smoke without fire

ja: 稼ぐに追いつく貧乏なし
en: poverty is a stranger to industry

ja: 我が身をつねって人の痛さを知れ
en: pinch yourself to know how others feel pain

ja: 寄る年波には勝てない
en: nobody can win against advancing age

ja: 急いては事を仕損ずる
en: haste makes waste

ja: 求めよさらば与えられん
en: ask, and it shall be given you

ja: 泣く子と地頭には勝てぬ
en: you cannot win against someone who doesn't listen to reason
we learn by teaching
enter through the narrow gate
money begets money
money talks
lend your money and lose your friend
no pain, no gain

ja: 君子危うきに近寄らず
en: a wise man keeps away from danger
a wise man changes his mind, a fool never

ja: 鶏口となるも牛後となる勿れ
en: better be the head of a dog than the tail of a lion
art brings bread

ja: 芸術は長く人生は短し
en: art is long, life is short
blood is thicker than water

ja: 健全なる精神は健全なる身体に宿る
en: a sound mind dwells in a sound body
reality can not compete with imagination

ja: 見ると聞くとは大違い
en: seeing something and hearing about it are very different

ja: 言うは易く行うは難し
en: it's easier said than done
there is no place like home

ja: 後は野となれ山となれ
en: I don't care what follows

ja: 乞食を三日すればやめられぬ
en: once a beggar, always a beggar
words can lead to disaster

ja: 喉元過ぎれば熱さを忘れる
en: once past the throat, the heat is forgotten

ja: 好きこそものの上手なれ
en: what one likes, one will do well
make hay while the sun shines

ja: 孝行のしたい時分に親はなし
en: when you are ready to be a filial child, your parents are already gone

ja: 慌てる乞食はもらいが少ない
en: the hasty beggar gets little

ja: 降りかかる火の粉は払わねばならぬ
en: you must protect yourself against any possible dangers

ja: この親にしてこの子あり
en: the apple doesn't fall far from the tree

ja: 今日は人の身明日は我が身
en: what happens to another today may happen to me tomorrow

ja: 最後に笑う者が最もよく笑う
en: he who laughs last, laughs best

ja: 山椒は小粒でもぴりりと辛い
en: the sansho pepper is small, but it bites

ja: 始め良ければ終わり良し
en: a good beginning makes a good ending

ja: 子を持って知る親の恩
en: becoming a parent makes you appreciate your own parents

ja: 死んだ子の年を数える

ja: 鹿を追う者は山を見ず

ja: 捨てる神あれば拾う神あり
en: if one god abandons you, another picks you up

ja: 弱き者よ汝の名は女なり
en: frailty, thy name is woman

ja: 朱に交われば赤くなる

ja: 終わりよければすべてよし

ja: 女の髪の毛には大象も繋がる

ja: 女は弱しされど母は強し
en: though the woman is weak, the mother is strong

ja: 勝てば官軍、負ければ賊軍
en: win and you are the imperial army; lose and you are rebels

ja: 寝るほど楽はなかりけり

ja: 深い川は静かに流れる

ja: 親はなくても子は育つ
